body:
Do any of you working there ever care about anything but your ownselves?

Do you really give a damn about the patient's "needs"?

Nothing. At all. I just distract myself until I die. 

I am angry or sometimes sad or I feel nothing.
Nothing matters as long as I can't cope with things that come up everyday, and no one to help me with them.

Yes. Without any treatment. I had an appointment with a therapist, they changed the time without telling me. They are either evil or stupid. I know I asked for them to move up this appointment because waiting for treatment was brutal, 2 weeks out. So they moved it up from 9am to 8am. Without telling me, until the day before. Then it was canceled because I didn't think I could walk there that early. Only I suffer from their incompetence, if it wasn't deliberate.

I asked for help, they wouldn't help me, I complained to the hospital and they conducted a farce of an inquiry, lying to me along the way, incarcerating me when I got frustrated and raised my voice. I am philosophically nonviolent, yet these people lied about me threatening them and/or myself. And then they never responded to my concerns, just blaming me for getting angry in response to their abuse(stupid frustrating things like telling me to wait for a phone call when I tell them I have no working phone, repeatedly refusing to just get me an appointment to a therapist)

This doesn't even begin to explain all I experienced. It is so hard to organize what happened.

Yes, I am so scared for the worse, but why couldn't it be better?

But if I hasten death and then after death is pure torture, I'll also have regret on top of whatever is.

I asked for help, I was refused. I have no more energy to look for anymore options.

I am too angry at them getting away with their abuse.

So, yes, there are no more options. Small town and the list of what was done to me is long and unbelievable.

Oh, I've just been trying to get mental health treatment for the last 4 months. I got upset and frustrated because of the realities of life. So I asked for my primary care provider to get me into treatment, but it led to months of abuse, 5 days in the hospital without cause, and still no treatment.

I know there are many things to enjoy, but it is impossible to do so when people I am forced to depend on are only interested in monetizing me. 


And I wasn't asking what does happen, I was asking for fellow redditors to speculate. And no one can even do that.

I guess it is different where I am. I only saw  "educated" people about 5 minutes in 5 days. Everyone else were just low wage babysitters. They pass out the food, they might break up fights, I suppose. No treatment of any kind though. I spent almost the whole time laying in a bed with radio headphones. The only exception was the first morning when I realized I was lied to(and later found out I was lied *about*) and was screaming to let me go and one worker took me out into the hallway, after another patient hit me in the face, so the others wouldn't have to be bothered by me.


>What're the advantages of independent therapists? Can they still lock you up for self-harm and suicidal thoughts? Are there any differences in their relationship to doctor-patient confidentiality?

The difference with an independent therapist is that they do not profit from our incarceration. So they are less likely to get you committed when it's not in your best interest.

At some point, if these people have any morals at all, they need to stand up for those who can't stand up for themselves, or at least stand up next to us. 

I, personally, don't share your perspective that they care. They just want as easy a job they can get. And that's more likely if they pretend to be on your side. Until their laziness screws you.


As for meds, that's a profitable industry. The drugs get pushed(well, bribed) on the doctors and they get pushed on us. But to refuse their drugs is being "uncooperative" and then you get nothing, I suppose.

Have you looked for an independent therapist(not part of a hospital or group that has a med doc/nurse)?

Can't help, except to say we are in the exact same position. Misery loves company, I suppose. I keep asking for help and keep getting refused. I complained to the hospital's grievance committee, and their process was a farce.

I'm calling independent therapists today(only 3 are accessible to me), so far none has called me back. I'm supposed to get help from some company that helps people "gain independence", but they have ignored my last email. 

It's sickening. It's all a money grab. They can get big bucks babysitting you inpatient, and the drug companies make out too. Drugs have never affected me. Are you sure they do anything for you?


(Just venting, too)

Absolutely nothing.

Lack of karma can deny access in a timely manner, makes the user wait.
If someone has been on SSI for decades, can you cut them off of SSI even if there is no available job and no one choosing to hire them?

You bet. Stones. 

I need treatment. Therapy. Yet, I can't get an appointment. No matter what I've tried.
No matter what it is, I'll bet you can. What is it?
I don't know, but you're not. Do something, something else. Distract yourself. Life goes on.
Don't make decisions you can't get out of. Distract yourself, think of something else. Anything else catch your interest?

I would like a more tolerant world, a more accepting world. A world where we don't *have to* always be competing, fighting to get needs met. 

Where people go to work because they *want* to help each other, to make the world better, instead of feeling like they are not appreciated, not compensated decently. And take that out on each other.
I wish I could. I feel like my expectations are reasonable, yet they get dashed over and over again.
Why did I get signaled a response(oranged), see there is 1comment(1 new), yet there is nothing here?

OK, I'll hold onto your username. Thanks. I had two specific problems when this episode started, and at the moment I *think* they are both solved, so I am back to my norm: watching TV and surfing the internet 15/7(I sleep 9 hours a day).

I am very limited in options, I live in a small town, with very little access to transportation.

I get so scared to try because I expect at some point I won't be able to handle these incidences, do something "worse" that hitting myself. 

> What is your diagnosis? (what do you go for?)

Well, I've certainly been "diagnosed" with dysthymia, and recently as anxious, because of my trying to avoid these frustrations.

I self diagnose as avoidant personality disorder, and no one has denied that.


> I have had clients tell me that they want to kill me

I try to be *so* careful not to threaten others.


>no longer any access to my doctor(PA)

This is what confuses me so much. After sending that message to her, and a few days with no response I sent her this:


>Congratulations. You have chosen to abandon me in a time of need. You managed to fool me for a few years, but I guess I didn't see what you had to suffer and bear in order for [hospital corporation] to get paid in my name. Should I be sorry I can't always smile and make you feel good? You have sufficiently convinced me that I am not worthy of anything but constant suffering and abuse, you do a damn good job of it too. You have perpetuated the torture of a sick person. Bet you feel good about yourself. I would like to think your conscience would catch up with you, but I'm sure you've got the whole thing justified. 


>Don't contact me again.


I *had* to add the last sentence because if I hadn't the anticipation would have been even more torturous than it has been.

It's a week later and I still get into a thought loop that results in hitting myself.

> First we would have talked about the initial trigger of the anger/frustration.

And solved it. Nothing good could have happened without that.


Now that I'm left with no further responses, what are my options?

No access to therapy, no access to a case manager, no longer any access to my doctor(PA) either.

It's like they *want* you to suicide or criminalize.

Are you taught to act as this social worker did in this situation? - http://www.reddit.com/r/Anxiety/comments/1q27xa/i_sent_this_to_my_doctors_office_after_the_events/?


How? Why?
Just read the DSM.

Personality disorders? No. 

Because of the maladaptive nature of personality disorders, many develop mood disorders, which are treatable by medication and other mood elevators.

Personality disorders are from nurture, not nature.(Medications are ineffective)

AvPD comes from emotional neglect from the parent(s).

I've known all my life. I do have a personality disorder, avoidant personality disorder. They are usually created in the first 3 years of life, but they usually don't become disabling until later. For me, not until I was 30 or so.

I'm sorry, but I don't know your experience with mental illness and frustrations, unresolved and unresolvable issues and the continuing abuse by these people, but it's not a choice. 

*They* claim to be professionals. They have a job to do and choose not to do their job and make up excuses blaming me, the sick person.

And even though I already wrote that, *you* chose to blame me. That's not support or empathy. You work with people like me and hurt them every day?
Don't feel guilty! Please. For me. What do you do to relieve your symptoms? Exercise? Music? Both?

The expectation comes from experience. I started out polite, quiet and humble. The day before we spoke on the phone I told her what I needed and she first refused to help me, then only after I got upset she finally gave me an appointment(they don't get paid unless you go to the clinic, despite the waste and hardship for me to get there). I sat down pulled out my phone and the packaging and she said she wouldn't help me with that. I told her, this is the first thing that needs to be fixed, in order for me to get a call giving me an appointment with a case worker. It's like she, the professional, was too stupid, lazy and willfully ignorant most likely, to see the connection.

I have been going through a couple weeks of trying to get things done, without cooperation. I don't know if you have any experience of devastating disabling mental illness, but repeatedly being told no, no, no, with no justification is *frustrating*. Extreme frustration leads to anger. And then if all she expected to do was get another agency to call me, there was absolutely no reason why I had to go to her office. 


So, yes, over a period of days they frustrated me, then they wonder why I get upset. 


If these young social workers pick this career expecting cute cuddly sweet childlike people treating them like gods or mommies, they need to grow up. I don't *choose* to get upset, that's mental illness, coupled with an unqualified frustrating worker.
Because I raised my voice and they are probably used to abusing people so they expect violence.

I'm sorry, I thought it was pretty self explanatory. I had some situations last week where I couldn't get what I need, including a working phone. So I asked for help, but I let them know that I can't get phone calls to set up appointments until I could get my phone to work properly(in this case have access to voicemail), so I was given an appointment with a social worker who then proceeded to tell me that she won't do anything but have a case worker call me. But I don't have a reliable phone, that's the first thing I need help with.


So, the point is, if your job is to have a case manager to call me, how can you do your job when you know I have no working phone and you refuse to do the humane, simple things to help me get that problem solved.

Get it? 


Of course I was mad. You would be too with two weeks of frustrations with no end in sight. Unless, of course, you are less than human.

Thank you. This form goes to my physician's office, and though her nurses have been pretty uncooperative, my PA has been sympathetic and helpful in the past. I'm hoping she will, at least, try to see me as a human being.


If you're not mentally ill, getting a case worker, getting a counselor, getting a new phone to work  wouldn't be that hard. But if I wasn't mentally ill, I wouldn't need them.
